idea-plugin.name: Secret & Card Leak Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Secret & Card Leak Guard — catch real PII before it hits a commit

A background inspection that scans every file — code, fixtures, .env, JSON, logs — for values that look like a real card number, IBAN, or US Social Security Number, and tells them apart from safe test data the same way a payment gateway or the SSA itself does.

  • Card numbers — Luhn-valid, but the BIN is not one of the well-known payment-gateway test ranges (the same ranges Kassi Test Data generates from).
  • IBAN — passes the ISO 7064 mod-97 check, but isn't one of Kassi's own reserved test IBANs.
  • US SSN — structurally issuable (area/group/serial outside the SSA's never-issued ranges), so it could plausibly be assigned to a real person.

Each finding comes with a one-click quick-fix: replace it with a synthetic, checksum-valid equivalent drawn from a reserved test range — so re-scanning never re-flags the fix.

100% offline and algorithmic. Zero network calls, zero data collection, nothing ever leaves your IDE.

More Kassi tools for QA & fintech: Kassi Test Data — generate valid IBANs, cards, BIC/SWIFT, VAT and national IDs; and Checksum & Regex Playground.

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
